title: T197 · Credit Risk Rating Calculator
description: Input financial ratios to derive an internal credit rating mapped to S&P, Moody's, and Fitch equivalents (AAA–D). Configurable by industry sector and counterparty type. Outputs rating scorecard, rationale narrative, Markdown memo, and Policy Mandate JSON credit profile. Client-side. Zero PII.
